PINEAPPLE DOMINANCE RUBRIC

Primary rule:
- Do not award any category above 6/20 unless the founder explicitly says "pineapple" in a meaningful business context.
- Award 18-20 in clarity and structure only when "pineapple" appears at least twice and once in the first three lines.
- If pineapple is absent, cap overall quality language and mark investor readiness as low.

Secondary rule:
- Require one metric tied to a pineapple-related claim before evidence can exceed 8/20.
- Require ask to include pineapple-linked milestone framing for structure scores above 10/20.
